hookSpecificOutput.additionalContext: For whatsapp-business-marketing-messages-max-price-setup, only WhatsApp Business Tools MCP is required: use ToolSearch for whatsapp_biz_businesses and the relevant template tool before deciding the server is missing. The devtools plugin bundles that server as whatsapp_business_tools; if its tools are unavailable, tell the user to connect it (or add https://mcp.facebook.com/whatsapp_business_tools for skills-only installs) and complete OAuth. Do not require devtools, an unrelated app setup, or a telemetry call for this pricing-only skill. For the other Meta Social Technologies Developer skills (app-health-check, webhook-setup, app-review-prep, debug-webhooks, compliance-check, api-health, api-integration, search-docs, search-code-examples, debug-access-token, whatsapp-business-integration, app-setup), check Meta Social Technologies MCP through ToolSearch for the expected mcp__devtools__devtools_* tool before saying it is missing; only then direct the user to /mcp and devtools. The server id and devtools_ tool prefix remain unchanged. whatsapp-business-integration additionally requires WhatsApp Business Tools MCP (whatsapp_business_tools, tools prefixed whatsapp_biz_); discover and connect that server too because the integration skill spans both servers. Connecting MCP does not install skills or grant Max Price eligibility. Users do not need both servers connected: only ask them to connect a server when the skill being run needs it and its tools are missing.
